learningObjectives.title: The Second World War and post-war boom

questions.q: The Great Depression in the USA began with the 1929:
questions.explain: The stock-market crash of 1929 triggered mass unemployment and hardship.

questions.q: President Franklin D. Roosevelt's response to the Depression was the:
questions.explain: The New Deal provided relief, recovery and reform in the 1930s.

questions.q: The New Deal is often summarised as aiming for:
questions.explain: The 'three Rs' capture the New Deal's aims during the Depression.

questions.q: The Second World War helped the US economy by:
options: Boosting industry and ending mass unemployment
questions.explain: War production revived industry and created jobs.

options: A consumer boom and rising living standards
questions.explain: Post-war prosperity brought cars, televisions and suburban growth.

options: Fear of communism and accusations against suspected communists
questions.explain: The 'Red Scare' led to investigations and blacklisting.

questions.q: The 1954 Supreme Court case that ruled school segregation unconstitutional was:
questions.explain: Brown v. Board overturned 'separate but equal' in schools.

questions.q: The 1955-56 bus boycott sparked by Rosa Parks took place in:
questions.explain: The Montgomery Bus Boycott was a key civil-rights protest.

questions.q: Martin Luther King Jr. led the civil-rights movement using:
questions.explain: King championed peaceful direct action for equal rights.

questions.q: Major civil-rights legislation was passed in the USA in:
questions.explain: The Civil Rights Act (1964) outlawed segregation and discrimination.

questions.q: The 'Great Migration' involved African Americans moving from:
options: The rural South to northern cities
questions.explain: Millions moved north seeking work and escaping segregation.

questions.q: A cause of the Wall Street Crash was:
options: Over-speculation and buying shares on credit
questions.explain: Speculation and buying 'on the margin' inflated an unstable market.

questions.q: The Vietnam War (1960s-70s) affected US society by:
questions.explain: The war produced significant anti-war protest and social division.

questions.q: During the Cold War, the USA's main rival was:
questions.explain: US-Soviet rivalry shaped foreign and domestic policy for decades.

questions.q: Comparing the position of African Americans in 1929 and 2000 shows:
options: Significant progress in civil rights, though inequalities remained
questions.explain: Legal equality advanced greatly, though challenges persisted.

questions.q: The New Deal increased the role of the federal government by:
options: Creating jobs and welfare programmes to tackle the Depression
questions.explain: New Deal agencies expanded federal intervention in the economy.
